import sys

MO = 1000000007

def qpow(x, n):
    ans = 1
    while n:
        if n & 1:
            ans = ans * x % MO
        x = x * x % MO
        n >>= 1
    return ans

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    P = int(data[0])
    K = int(data[1])

    if K == 0:
        sys.stdout.write(str(qpow(P, P - 1)))
        return

    if K == 1:
        sys.stdout.write(str(qpow(P, P)))
        return

    # cycle detection
    vis = [False] * P
    p = 1
    cycle_len = 0
    while not vis[p]:
        cycle_len += 1
        vis[p] = True
        p = (K * p) % P

    sys.stdout.write(str(qpow(P, P // cycle_len)))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
